chapter: Chicago pioneers, community and New Orleans brotherhood
title: Dave Peyton's band at the Regal and the shooting at Jasper Taylor
summary: Dave Peyton's Regal band featured Reuben Reeves and Armstrong, and drummer Jasper Taylor's girlfriend once shot at him on stage.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yeah, he was the same -- see, those bands 15, 16, 17 men. And they just had a front man, he would be like the front man for them. Right, and so this is what happened. Then across the street at the Regal Theatre, they had Dave Peyton. He had his big band in there, with Rueben Reeves -- was a terrific trumpet player at that time.

And people used to lay for those shows and stage A when they would bring Louis Armstrong in there, man, this was really the thing, because you're going to hear Rueben Reeves and you'll hear Louis Armstrong.
And they were household names, and people --

Oh, yeah, right. Everybody knew them. I mean, the whole family, the whole personnel. And it was a funny thing, they had a drummer, Jasper Taylor, playing in that band. And Jasper, one of his girlfriends came in one night, shot at him on the stage.
No, didn't hit him. But everybody fell down. You can imagine. And that was a big thing for years that they used to talk about a lot.
Yeah, Jasper Taylor, and Dave Peyton, Dave used to write music and all that. He was a pianist, and (inaudible).
He used to write a column for the --
Chicago Defender, yeah, right, right right.
Always talking about the proper dress.
